shared_clusters.name: TripoSG / diso family

shared_clusters.name: Local image models family
shared_clusters.risk_summary: Shared local-image-models entries reuse a common diffusers runtime family, but auth and GPU expectations still vary by model card.
shared_clusters.notes: FLUX remains gated while SD15 and SDXL Base stay non-gated unless future evidence changes that.

shared_clusters.name: UniRig native dependency family
shared_clusters.risk_summary: UniRig depends on Blender Python, sparse-conv, PyG-native wheels, and lane-specific CUDA wheels that are highly ABI-sensitive.
shared_clusters.notes: Cluster records package-family risk only; it does not validate any particular wheel combination.

shared_clusters.name: Kimodo gated encoder family
shared_clusters.risk_summary: Kimodo is lighter on native ABI risk than 3D families, but gated encoder access, optional MotionCorrection handling, and high VRAM text-conditioning paths still affect real usability.
shared_clusters.notes: MotionCorrection is documented as skipped or optional rather than a required dependency lane.

shared_clusters.name: PyTorch accelerator lanes
shared_clusters.risk_summary: Torch package records must state lane evidence or unknowns instead of inferring GPU support.
shared_clusters.notes: ROCm is unknown for all V1 entries.

shared_clusters.name: PyG / sparse convolution family
shared_clusters.risk_summary: Sparse-conv, PyG-native, and attention acceleration packages have high ABI and wheel-lane risk.
shared_clusters.notes: Optional/fallback flags remain per package record.

shared_clusters.name: Model weight access and large download risk
shared_clusters.risk_summary: Model refs do not prove download success, auth status, checksums, or Modly ownership.
shared_clusters.notes: Auth is unknown unless a model record states otherwise.
